critical.issue: Claim ops transitions all return 500 because claims.service.ts:197 unconditionally inserts (claim_id, outcome=dto.to, adjustment_minor, decided_by) into claims.claim_decisions on EVERY status change. `claim_decisions.outcome` has CHECK (outcome IN ('APPROVED','PARTIAL','REJECTED')), so any intermediate transition (EVIDENCE_VALIDATION, UNDER_REVIEW, PROPOSED_RESOLUTION, FINANCIAL_ADJUSTMENT, CLOSED) violates the check constraint. Also there is a UNIQUE(claim_id) on claim_decisions so at most one row can ever be inserted. Fix: only insert a claim_decisions row on terminal decision statuses (APPROVED/REJECTED/PARTIAL); other transitions should just UPDATE claims.claims.status + write audit. Verified via curl: /api/claims/c2823360.../transition {"to":"EVIDENCE_VALIDATION"} → 500 INTERNAL_ERROR; log: `new row for relation "claim_decisions" violates check constraint "claim_decisions_outcome_check"`.

Reporting a temperature excursion returns 500 because logistics.temperature_excursion_events.duration_seconds is NOT NULL in migration 006/012, but the DTO/service (shipments.service.ts:262-268) passes `dto.durationSeconds ?? null`. Since the field is optional in TemperatureExceptionDto and UI doesn't collect it, every excursion POST fails. Consequence: shipment.acceptance_hold is never set, buyer acceptance is NOT blocked, control tower openShipmentExceptions queue never populates. Fix options: (a) drop NOT NULL on duration_seconds; (b) require durationSeconds in DTO and UI; (c) coalesce to 0 in insert. Log: `null value in column "duration_seconds" of relation "temperature_excursion_events" violates not-null constraint`.

Was returning 500 because claims.service.ts:264 ORDER BY created_at but claim_decisions has decided_at (no created_at). Testing agent changed ORDER BY to decided_at and restarted florasetu-api; endpoint now returns 200 with evidences/decisions arrays. ClaimDetailPage now loads.

rca of the issue: Two independent regressions in Build 4 pilot: (i) claims.service.ts transition() writes a claim_decisions row every call — the code was likely copy-pasted between 'record decision' and 'transition state', but claim_decisions is (per schema) an immutable terminal-decision ledger with CHECK on outcome and UNIQUE per claim; (ii) temperature_excursion_events schema requires duration_seconds NOT NULL but the manual-report DTO makes it optional and the UI never collects it, so every manual excursion 500s. Both bugs are pure code/schema issues, not env or infra.
